content:
As widely expected, Apple TV announced today that Widow’s Bay will be returning for a second season. Here are the details.

Widow’s Bay to return for a second season

With just one episode to go for season 1, Apple TV announced today that Widow’s Bay has been confirmed for a second season.

The show premiered last April to broad critical acclaim and a Certified Fresh rating on Rotten Tomatoes, and has since shot up to the top of Apple TV’s charts in many countries, including the US.

Widow’s Bay’s cast includes Matthew Rhys (The Post), Kate O’Flynn (Happy-Go-Lucky), Stephen Root (Breaking Bad), Kevin Carroll (The Leftovers), Dale Dickey (Breaking Bad), Hamish Linklater (The Big Short), among others.

Here’s the show’s synopsis, according to Apple:

Alongside the season two renewal, Apple TV announced a new multiyear overall deal with Widow’s Bay creator, showrunner, and executive producer Katie Dippold, but the company did not disclose further details.

Right now, there are also no details about when the show is expected to return after it concludes its first season next week, nor whether the cast will see any additions or departures.
